name: @aloud/aloud-tts
description: React Native native module bridging AVSpeechSynthesizer/TextToSpeech and the shared aloud_core Rust engine. Autolinked via CocoaPods (iOS) and Gradle (Android) — a consuming app just installs it, no manual Xcode/Android Studio wiring.
//files: The xcframework and jniLibs are build OUTPUTS (produced by scripts/build-ios-core.sh / build-android-core.sh from the Rust core), excluded from what npm would publish but present locally once built. See the root README's 'Running the example app' section.
//no-codegen: This registers via the classic RN bridge (RCTEventEmitter / ReactContextBaseJavaModule) matching AloudTtsSpec.ts in @aloud/app, not the new-arch TurboModule codegen — so there is deliberately no `codegenConfig` here.
